checks.name: a1-scope-boundary-declared-before-any-code
checks.summary: SCOPE BOUNDARY, authored before any code edit in this task. ROW 1 -- what this task makes true: the environment a child process receives has exactly one authority, and that is enforced by the ABSENCE of any other field able to carry one -- provider.Invocation loses its Environment field, internal/runner loses Grant.Apply and ProviderClient.Grant -- and a provider-preflight record that declares an environment.granted_names the runner has no channel to deliver now refuses the invocation fail-closed, after LoadPreflightRecord and strictly before Ledger.Reserve, with no process started and no reservation debited. ROW 2 -- what it deliberately does NOT do: it widens nothing any child may reach; it adds no environment entry to any child; it delivers no credential to any child; it changes no mount; it changes no argv; and it changes the bytes a real claude child receives not at all. ROW 3 -- what it RECORDS but does not fix: SupervisedInvocationRunner.ExtraEnv, the one declared additive environment source outside the approved record, set in exactly one place in the tree for dp-v2-017 B16/I7's transport-failure diagnostic; and Grant.id, a field written by randomGrantID and read by nothing (dp-v2-078 d11). Neither is changed. ROW 4 -- what only a LATER task can establish: actual delivery of a granted name to a real child, in the shape dp-v2-078 d7 names (SupervisedInvocationRunner leasing exactly the names the approved record declares, names from the record and values from the broker), with its own credential-isolation acceptance. ROW 5 -- this task closes a LATENT defect and no open hole, in those words: no non-test file constructs a SecretBroker, no file in the tree assigns ProviderClient.Grant, all three approved records declare granted_names empty, contracts rule 4 forbids a non-empty granted_names for claude which is the only provider any record names, and cmd/runner/main.go carries no provider wiring at all. What this task buys is that the day something IS granted, the system refuses loudly instead of running with a silently narrower environment. ROW 6 -- this task passes no release gate and satisfies no M6 completion condition.
